2607.13511.title: ExTernD: Expanded-Rank Ternary Decomposition Ternary LLM PTQ with Accuracy Approaching Any Quantization Level
2607.13511.paper_summary: We introduce ExTernD (Expanded-rank Ternary Decomposition), a post-training factorization of each LLM weight matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ into $A \approx B \mathrm{diag}(D) C$ with ternary factors $B \in \{-1,0,+1\}^{m \times k}$, $C \in \{-1,0,+1\}^{k \times n}$ and a real scale vector $D \in \mathbb{R}^k$. The inner rank $k = μ\min(m,n)$ is deliberately expanded beyond full rank ($μ> 1$), so that components past full rank correct the quantization error of earlier ones. We prove the residual decreases monotonically in $k$ and can be driven below any $\varepsilon > 0$: ExTernD approaches bf16 accuracy arbitrarily closely, which no ternary scheme with a fixed plane count can do. Memory and compute scale continuously with $μ$, and factor sparsity continuously with a threshold $τ$, so an accuracy target is hit exactly rather than rounded to the next bit-width. ExTernD matches Q4_K's per-matrix accuracy at 5.2-5.5 effective bpw (5.1-5.5 with importance weighting) on Gemma-4-E2B and Qwen3.5-4B, and a full Qwen3.5-4B conversion at $μ= 3$ reaches 10.10 wikitext-2 perplexity against 9.78 for bf16 (+3.2%), placing it near the Q4_K/Q5_K accuracy band at ~5.7 effective bpw.
2607.13511.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 ExTernD（擴展秩三元分解），這是一種對每個 LLM 權重矩陣 $A \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ 的後訓練因式分解，形式為 $A \approx B \mathrm{diag}(D) C$，其中三元因子 $B \in \{-1,0,+1\}^{m \times k}$，$C \in \{-1,0,+1\}^{k \times n}$，以及實數尺度向量 $D \in \mathbb{R}^k$。內部秩 $k = μ\min(m,n)$ 被故意擴展到超過滿秩（$μ> 1$），以便超過滿秩的組件能夠修正之前組件的量化誤差。我們證明殘差在 $k$ 中單調減少，並且可以驅動到任意 $\varepsilon > 0$ 之下：ExTernD 可以任意接近 bf16 的準確度，而沒有任何固定平面數的三元方案能做到這一點。記憶體和計算隨著 $μ$ 連續增長，因子稀疏性隨著閾值 $τ$ 連續變化，因此準確度目標是精確達成，而不是四捨五入到下一個位寬。ExTernD 在 Gemma-4-E2B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 上以 5.2-5.5 的有效 bpw（5.1-5.5 具有重要性加權）達到 Q4_K 的每矩陣準確度，而在 $μ= 3$ 下的完整 Qwen3.5-4B 轉換達到 10.10 的 wikitext-2 困惑度，相對於 bf16 的 9.78（+3.2%），使其接近 Q4_K/Q5_K 準確度範圍，約為 5.7 的有效 bpw。
2607.13511.author: Chethan Reddy G. P et.al.
